name: KMK 25 flag is raised after three enforcements in two years
title: SC-11-08-02 KMK 25 flag is raised after three enforcements in two years
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given an owner enforced three times in two years
When the case history is evaluated
Then the KMK 25 flag is raised
